common.tagline: All your links, strung together in one place — in every language.

home.heroTitle: One link in bio. Every language in the world.
home.heroSubtitle: Linketto is the multilingual link-in-bio page: your profile speaks each visitor's language. Hosted in the EU, with reduced commissions and honest pricing.
home.featureLangBody: One page, many languages: visitors see your profile in their own language, automatically.
home.featureFeeBody: Just 5% on the free plan and 0% on all paid plans — versus 12% elsewhere.
home.featureAnalyticsBody: We count clicks, not people. No personal data and no consent banner.
home.featureTrustBody: Transparent moderation with notice and the right to appeal. Never a shameful banner on your page.
home.featureEuBody: Your data stays in the European Union. GDPR by default.
home.featureDomainBody: Custom domains on paid plans — your reputation never depends on someone else's abuse.
home.featureAiBody: Write in your language — Linketto translates your profile into all the others with one button.
home.featureQrBody: A QR code in your color and a vCard block that saves your contact to any phone with one tap.

legal.privacyBody: Linketto is a service of Carbon Stealth VCC (company ID BG208725180, ul. Samuil 3, 2670 Bobov Dol, Bulgaria, info@carbonstealth.eu). We process only the data needed to run the service: your email and (hashed) password, and the content you choose to publish. Our analytics are cookieless and store no personal data about visitors — we do not keep IP addresses. Data is stored in the European Union. You have the right to access, rectify, erase and port your data under the GDPR — contact us at info@carbonstealth.eu. (Draft — subject to legal review before launch.)
legal.termsBody: By using Linketto you agree not to publish illegal content, malicious links or misleading information. In case of a violation we notify you first and you have the right to appeal; profiles are not suspended without notice, except for severe abuse requiring immediate action under the law. Paid plans are billed via Stripe; you can cancel at any time and your plan stays active until the end of the paid period. The service is provided by Carbon Stealth VCC. (Draft — subject to legal review before launch.)
